title: The Relay
text: The mast is old. Its footings are coursed like the stone on the east ridge, and its dish is aimed straight down at Home. Inside its housing a buffer is filling. The newest packet is last sol's Biosphere Report: our header, our checksum, our packet format, down to the padding.

lines.text: "It isn't only receiving. It's forwarding. Three carriers go out from here. One of them points at Ash. I can't see where the other two go."
"And there's a field in our header I always took for padding. The margin field. Here it's filled in. One number, every sol. It goes up when we do well."

choices.label: Copy the buffer
choices.reply: Copied: every report since Sol 1, with the number beside each one.

choices.label: Leave it as it is
choices.reply: You leave it running. Whoever reads it at the other end needn't know you were here.

notes: The margin field is the score (STORY.md §6); proof-ready's drive has "every report we ever sent, with the margin field left in".
